title: Test365Alm M09 manual execution slice
description: The first persisted test-set, manifest, run and attempt contract. It is intentionally limited to MANUAL execution.

pagination.ordering: stable resource-specific keyset order; callers must follow nextCursor rather than increasing an offset

filters.runsPage.testSetId: optional UUID; the test-set join is applied before the database keyset limit
filters.runSummary.testSetId: optional UUID; when supplied all counts are restricted to instances in that test set

history.attemptsPage: items are bounded AttemptSummary records without steps; follow the attempt path for the selected attempt's full step detail
history.runDetail: contains at most the current-attempt preview; complete attempt history is cursor-paged

query.testSetId: optional UUID; absent means the complete authorized project

summary.scopeRule: The response is project scoped when testSetId is absent and test-set scoped when it is present; the UI must label the selected scope.
summary.latestRule: latest finished attempt per test instance by finished_at, then attempt_no

idempotency.replay: The first successful response is frozen and replayed only after authorization; legacy rows without a frozen response are rejected with IDEMPOTENCY_RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE

versioning.stepWrite: If-Match is a strong quoted positive integer for the target run_step; expectedVersion in JSON must match it when both are supplied
versioning.attemptWrite: Pause, resume and finish use the target run_attempt rowVersion and accept the same strong If-Match/expectedVersion rule
versioning.stale: 409/412 business error; no partial step, event, audit or outbox write
